rule.description: A designated API entry point matches when its body carries monolithic inline re-implementation mass (recursive executable statements at or above the entry's threshold) and contains no delegation call to any module-scope, project-defined helper function; the module-scope helper inventory is recomputed from the analyzed state, so renamed or relocated helpers still count as valid delegation. Both conditions describe one structural relation: the entry point re-implements a responsibility that should be owned by a well-scoped, reusable method.

checks.description: Flag a public entry point of the versioning/comparison surface whose body has grown into an inline monolith and which no longer calls any module-scope helper of the project, meaning its algorithm is re-implemented in place instead of delegated to a well-scoped, reusable method.
checks.detected_relation: entry function -> inlined re-implementation of a module-scope helper algorithm (delegation edge removed, monolithic body present)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Deeply inlined method: the sub-method implementations that used to sit behind the entry point (the list-diff routine, its module-private per-property equality helper, and the version-ordering comparator) were copied into the entry point itself with restructured idioms; detection measures exactly that copied-in mass together with the disappearance of the delegating call.

matches.evidence: minVersionBump contains 44 recursive executable statements (delegation absent): a self-contained index-and-scan re-implementation of the shared token-list diff, with the shallow per-field value comparison (strict equality, type-mismatch, element-wise array prefix test) of the absorbed module-private helper inlined one level deeper inside its own change-detection loop - three nested levels of formerly separate implementations inside one function frame. Clean form: 8 statements delegating to diffTokenLists; injected form performs diff.added/removed/changed existence tracking with local Map/Set bookkeeping and then classifies.

diffTokenLists contains 36 recursive executable statements and no call to any module-scope helper: its module-private equality helper compareTokenInfoProperty was deleted and the comparison branches (strict equality, type mismatch, element-wise array comparison) are embedded directly in the change-detection loop, merged with the field filtering that used to precede it. Clean form: 24 statements including a call to compareTokenInfoProperty.

isVersionUpdate contains 13 recursive executable statements and no call to any module-scope helper: the delegated ordering call (versionComparator base<update) was replaced by a hand-rolled six-branch guard ladder over major/minor/patch in reversed operand order, and the import of the shared comparator was dropped. Clean form: a single return statement delegating to versionComparator.

excluded.reason: Leaf function with no reducible body mass and a long but single-purpose else-if ladder; it is the surviving shared helper the predicate is supposed to delegate to. It is deliberately below the entry thresholds reached by re-implementation and is not part of the credited coverage.
Leaf upgrade classifier; no sub-method to inline; unchanged.
Leaf next-version computation; no sub-method to inline; unchanged.
